fields_unknown.not_material_reason: No forecast is given, but the observed 60% yearly growth and 25 GB a month of database growth give the planning rate; the pipeline is a separate unknown.
No speed target is named; the clock-in worry is uptime, which the 99.9% promise covers.
The 99.9% monthly uptime promise already bounds downtime at about 43 minutes a month.
No retention period is named; it sets deletion jobs, not the shape of the options.
No third party is named that receives staff data beyond the customers' own payroll and identity providers, keyed as outside systems.
No threat or incident is named; SOC 2 and single sign-on carry the security work.
Teams are named by area, not technology; with 14 engineers, skills do not narrow the options as they do for a team of two.
